pages.description: Bluestone Investment Partners is a lower middle market private equity firm specializing in defense and government solutions & technology sector.

blocks.intro: Bluestone Investment Partners is a lower middle market private equity firm focused on investing in defense and government technology companies.

blocks.title: Partners for Growth
blocks.body: Bluestone partners with leadership teams to accelerate growth and create value through a combination of organic growth initiatives and add-on acquisitions. The extensive industry-focus and experience of our team offers unique insights and value to our companies.

pages.title: About
pages.description: Bluestone Investment Partners is a private equity firm focused on the lower middle market Government Services and Technology sector.

blocks.title: Our Firm
paragraphs: Bluestone Investment Partners seeks to invest in technology and product companies serving the defense and government sector. We partner with mission-driven, growth-oriented leadership teams, pairing their insights and experience with our resources, relationships, and M&A expertise. Together, we create long-term value by driving growth through both organic initiatives and targeted acquisitions.

blocks.title: Defense & Government
blocks.subtitle: Sector Focus
paragraphs: Our team has spent decades working in the defense and government sector, gaining hands-on experience as business operators and financial professionals. Over the years, we have led and advised companies across a wide range of transactions, navigating complex regulations, market trends, and strategic growth initiatives.
This long-standing, sector-focused experience gives Bluestone a deep understanding of the industry's unique dynamics and enables our team to support portfolio companies in creating lasting value.

blocks.title: Empowering Leadership Teams
blocks.body: Bluestone's investment philosophy centers on partnering with leadership teams who bring knowledge, proven leadership, and a passion for growth. We believe the most successful partnerships are built on collaboration, combining the insights, experience, and operational expertise of leadership with Bluestone's extensive resources, strategic guidance, and network of relationships. By working closely together, Bluestone and leadership aim to drive meaningful transformation within businesses, creating long-term value through a combination of disciplined organic growth initiatives and strategic add-on acquisitions.

quotes.quote: Within the first 12 months of our partnership, Bluestone helped us complete two strategic add-on acquisitions that fundamentally changed our trajectory. Those transactions not only added scale, but also unlocked new organic growth opportunities that accelerated the business well beyond our original plan. Bluestone's extensive and strategic guidance were instrumental in helping us capitalize on that momentum.
quotes.author: Dave Hart

quotes.quote: From the start, Bluestone understood that CTI was a deeply mission-focused company. They partnered with us to make the targeted technology investments that strengthened our capabilities and enhanced our positioning with Special Operations Forces and Indo-Pacific Command. That kind of focused investment was what enabled us to keep serving our nation's warfighters at the highest level.
quotes.author: Jay Moorman

quotes.quote: Bluestone's strategic acquisition model worked exactly as advertised. Over our 3-year partnership, we grew cBEYONData nearly tenfold through a disciplined mix of add-on acquisitions and new business wins. They were a true partner in execution, not just a source of capital.
quotes.author: Dave Schmidtknecht

quotes.quote: At Precise Systems, we put our people first, and Bluestone has been a partner that operates the same way. In the first three years of our partnership, we've more than doubled the size of the company while preserving the culture we worked hard to build. We're now positioned to pursue contracts of scale that wouldn't have been within reach before.
quotes.author: Scott Pfister

articles.title: Valiant Solutions Acquires Abile Group to Expand Cybersecurity Support for National Security Missions
articles.excerpt: Valiant Solutions has acquired Abile Group, a provider of secure network and cyber engineering services and technology to National Security customers.

paragraphs: Valiant Solutions, a provider of cybersecurity technologies and services to U.S. Federal agencies, today announced the acquisition of Abile Group, a provider of secure network and cyber engineering services and technology to National Security customers.

The acquisition reinforces Valiant's strategy to build a market leader of scale across cybersecurity to address the evolving cyber, information assurance, and digital risk requirements of Federal and National Security customers. Together, Valiant and Abile deliver enhanced cybersecurity capabilities through a unified team focused on protecting, modernizing, and operating mission critical systems in complex and high-threat environments.

articles.title: Qualis, InTrack Radar Technologies, and Tektonux Announce Merger Creating Missile Defense and Space Domain Awareness Platform
articles.shortTitle: Qualis, InTrack Radar Technologies, and Tektonux Announce Merger Creating Defense Focused Platform
articles.excerpt: Qualis, InTrack Radar Technologies, and Tektonux have merged to form a company combining hardware and software products for missile defense, space domain awareness, integrated fires, and electronic warfare.

paragraphs: Qualis, InTrack Radar Technologies ("InTrack"), and Tektonux today announced their merger to form a company combining hardware and software products for the agile modernization of missile defense, space domain awareness, integrated fires, and electronic warfare. The new company – a portfolio company of Bluestone Investment Partners – iteratively improves missions through advanced signals engineering and artificial intelligence-enabled software solutions, better supporting customers across the U.S. Army, U.S. Space Force, U.S. Air Force, Missile Defense Agency (MDA), and NASA.

The combined platform produces specialized hardware and software faster than the pace of near-peer enemies to identify, track, and respond to emerging threats and rapidly-evolving missions. Its integrated solutions introduce cutting-edge capabilities to improve the performance of ballistic missile early warning and space surveillance systems. The company's Phoenix NexGen User Experience Framework integrates artificial intelligence agents into human teams for C2 missions and missile defense applications. Additional capabilities support signal collection and analysis in contested electromagnetic environments.

articles.title: Precise Systems Announces Acquisition of Mission Focused Systems
articles.shortTitle: Precise Systems Announces Acquisition of Mission Focused Systems to Strengthen Engineering Capabilities
articles.excerpt: Precise Systems has acquired Mission Focused Systems, expanding its portfolio in advanced engineering, digital transformation, interactive training and simulation, and platform lifecycle support.

paragraphs: Precise Systems, a company that delivers innovative offerings to the Department of Defense, has acquired Mission Focused Systems.

Precise Systems said the acquisition of the Royersford, Pennsylvania-headquartered MFS is meant to reinforce its dedication to empowering the warfighter with mission-critical capabilities. The move expands Precise Systems' portfolio in advanced engineering, digital transformation, interactive training and simulation, and platform lifecycle support by integrating MFS's expertise in agile systems engineering, research, experimentation, and prototyping services. The acquisition also boosts Precise Systems' capabilities in program management and training support across space, C4ISR, enterprise information systems and system-of-systems.

articles.title: Bluestone Completes the Successful Sale of CTI
articles.excerpt: Parsons Corporation has acquired Maryland-based Chesapeake Technologies International, Corp (CTI), a portfolio company of Bluestone Investment Partners, in a transaction valued at $89 million.

paragraphs: Parsons Corporation (NYSE:PSN) announced today that it has acquired Maryland-based Chesapeake Technologies International, Corp (CTI), a portfolio company of Bluestone Investment Partners, in a transaction valued at $89 million.

Founded in 2000, CTI strengthens Parsons' defense customer posture with the Special Operations forces and enhances Parsons' position in the Indo-Pacific Command (INDOPACOM) area of operations. CTI brings extensive capabilities as an all-domain technology solutions provider, powered by cutting-edge products that enhance the warfighters' ability to sense, evaluate and deliver effects within the invisible battlespaces. These capabilities are critical for modern warfare and align with the new administration's spending priorities.

articles.title: Bluestone Completes the Successful Sale of cBEYONData
articles.excerpt: SMX, a leader in next-generation mission support, digital transformation, and IT solutions, has acquired cBEYONData, creating a leading provider of differentiated digital transformation capabilities for government customers.

paragraphs: SMX, a leader in next-generation mission support, digital transformation, and IT solutions, today announced the acquisition of cBEYONData. cBEYONData is a provider of implementation, design, and managed service capabilities, as well as a proprietary portfolio of budget management and financial analytics solutions that provide real-time data visibility and transparency to customers within the Department of Defense (DoD) and federal civilian agencies. Together, SMX and cBEYONData are well-positioned to support customers across the public sector, helping them achieve enhanced visibility, operational efficiency, and financial transparency.

The acquisition creates a leading provider of differentiated digital transformation capabilities, offering a tailored set of solutions that help government customers manage their increasingly complex financial, planning, and analytical needs. Expertise spans across top financial platforms like Oracle, SAP, and Momentum, while ensuring enhanced scalability, flexibility, and security driven by the Company's strong relationships with leading cloud infrastructure providers such as Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.

articles.title: Bluestone Announces Strategic Investment in Federal Cybersecurity Leader, Valiant Solutions, LLC
articles.excerpt: Bluestone Investment Partners has announced a strategic investment in Valiant Solutions, LLC, a leading provider of enterprise-wide cybersecurity services for Federal agencies.

paragraphs: Bluestone Investment Partners, a McLean, Virginia-based private equity firm, has announced a strategic investment in Valiant Solutions, LLC, a leading provider of enterprise-wide cybersecurity services for Federal agencies. Concurrent with the investment, George Wilson and Tom Weston, seasoned leaders in the government technology sector, have joined the leadership team to drive Valiant's next phase of growth.

Founded in 2005, Valiant is a pure-play cybersecurity provider to federal agencies. The Company specializes in advanced threat detection data analytics, zero trust architecture implementation, compliance and risk assessment solutions, and cloud and container security. Valiant leverages proprietary software frameworks to integrate and maintain market leading cybersecurity solutions to ensure customers are at the forefront of cybersecurity technical innovation.

articles.title: Precise Systems Announces Acquisition of Tucson Embedded Systems
articles.excerpt: Precise Systems has acquired Tucson Embedded Systems, LLC (TES), a provider of high-performance computing systems and software solutions for the Department of Defense.

paragraphs: Precise Systems, Inc., a portfolio company of Bluestone Investment Partners, is pleased to announce the acquisition of Tucson Embedded Systems, LLC (TES).

Founded in 1992, TES is a Tucson, Arizona-based provider of high-performance computing systems and software solutions for the Department of Defense and other government customers. TES designs and delivers mission-critical avionics, embedded computing platforms, and software solutions used in helicopters, fixed-wing aircraft, and unmanned systems. The addition of TES expands Precise Systems' advanced engineering capabilities and strengthens its ability to support customers across the U.S. Navy, U.S. Army, and U.S. Air Force.

articles.title: Bluestone Investment Partners Announces Investment in Missile Defense and Space Technology Business Qualis Corporation
articles.excerpt: Bluestone Investment Partners has completed a strategic investment in Qualis Corporation, a missile defense and space systems technology business based in Huntsville, Alabama.

paragraphs: Bluestone Investment Partners has announced that it has completed a strategic investment in Qualis Corporation, a missile defense and space systems technology business based in Huntsville, Alabama.

Qualis supports the development of next-generation missile defense and satellite communications systems with advanced modeling, simulation, and testing services. The company's expertise in modeling and simulating RF waveforms is enabling the development of resilient communications and navigation in GPS-denied and contested environments. Qualis' customers include U.S. Army Space and Missile Defense Command, U.S. Air Force Test Center, U.S. Space Force, the Space Development Agency, the Missile Defense Agency, and NASA.

articles.title: CTI Announces Acquisition of Asymmetric Technologies LLC
articles.excerpt: Chesapeake Technology International (CTI) has acquired Asymmetric Technologies LLC, expanding CTI's product portfolio with advanced IronClad and Whisper products for flight autonomy and edge communications.

paragraphs: Chesapeake Technology International, Corp. (CTI), a leader in the development and integration of government-open solutions for the invisible battlespaces, announced today that it has acquired Asymmetric Technologies LLC. The acquisition will expand CTI's product portfolio by integrating Asymmetric's advanced IronClad and Whisper products to support flight autonomy and edge communications across Department of Defense and National Security customers.

Founded in 2011, Asymmetric specializes in the development of open-source technology tailored to mission-specific needs, complementing CTI's technology approach to Sense, Evaluate, and deliver Effects to the invisible battlespaces. The Asymmetric commitment to quality engineering and innovative design has established them as a preferred vendor to support edge communication and situational awareness needs of operational customers.

articles.title: Government Technology Veterans George Wilson and Tom Weston Partner with Bluestone Investment Partners
articles.excerpt: Bluestone Investment Partners has announced a partnership with seasoned government technology leaders George Wilson and Tom Weston to invest and grow a mission-critical technology provider for the Federal Government.

paragraphs: Bluestone Investment Partners, a McLean, Virginia-based private equity firm focused on investing in the defense and government technology sector, today announced a partnership with seasoned government technology leaders, George Wilson and Tom Weston. Messrs. Wilson and Weston have extensive strategy, operational, and M&A experience, and proven records of value creation in the defense and government technology sector.

Together, the partnership will invest and grow a mission-critical technology provider for the Federal Government across civilian, defense, healthcare, and national security agencies. Their investment criteria prioritize federal technology providers with annual revenues surpassing $25 million, possessing an unrestricted contracting profile, and demonstrating alignment with federal digital modernization priorities.

articles.title: Precise Systems Announces Acquisition of JHT
articles.excerpt: Precise Systems has acquired Jardon & Howard Technologies (JHT), a leading provider of advanced training and simulation solutions for clients across the Department of Defense.

paragraphs: Precise Systems, Inc., a portfolio company of Bluestone Investment Partners, is pleased to announce the acquisition of Jardon & Howard Technologies, Inc. (JHT) in a transaction that closed February 16, 2024.

Based in Orlando, Florida, JHT is a leading provider of advanced training and simulation solutions for clients across the Department of Defense, including the Army, Navy, and other agencies throughout the federal government. In support of these customers' training requirements, JHT develops interactive courseware, virtual training simulations, and human performance improvement tools such as Interactive Electronic Technical Manuals.

articles.title: Precise Systems Announces Acquisition of Excet, Inc.
articles.excerpt: Precise Systems has acquired Excet, Inc., a Springfield, Virginia-based provider of scientific research and engineering services to the Department of Defense.

paragraphs: Precise Systems, Inc., a portfolio company of Bluestone Investment Partners, is pleased to announce the acquisition of Excet, Inc. in a transaction that closed Friday, November 10, 2023.

Founded in 2005, Excet is a Springfield, Virginia-based provider of scientific research and engineering services to the Department of Defense. The company offers physical sciences research to the U.S. Army and U.S. Navy through multiple contract vehicles. Excet has proven expertise in Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear, and Explosives (CBRNE) threat assessment, biotechnology, chemistry, corrosion control, alternative energy, threat agent sciences, synthetic biology, and canine olfaction.

articles.title: ManTech Chairman Kevin Phillips Joins Bluestone as Executive Partner
articles.excerpt: Kevin M. Phillips, former President and CEO of ManTech and current Chairman of the Board, has joined Bluestone Investment Partners as an Executive Partner.

paragraphs: Bluestone Investment Partners, a McLean, Virginia-based private equity firm focused on investing in defense, intelligence and federal technology solutions providers, today announced that Kevin M. Phillips has joined the team as an Executive Partner. Phillips currently serves as the Chairman of the Board for ManTech, a high-tech, high-end engineering and cyber company dedicated to serving the national and homeland security needs of federal government customers.

Phillips led the successful sale of ManTech to Carlyle in September 2022 for $4.2 billion. His tenure at ManTech includes serving as President and Chief Executive Officer from 2018 until his retirement in October 2022; Chief Operating Officer from 2016 to 2018; Chief Financial Officer from 2005 to 2016; and Chief of Staff and Assistant to the Chairman from 2002 to 2005.

articles.title: Bluestone Announces Board of Advisors
articles.excerpt: Bluestone Investment Partners has announced the formation of its Board of Advisors, which includes five renowned industry leaders who will provide strategic guidance to the firm and its portfolio companies.

paragraphs: Bluestone Investment Partners, LP, a McLean, Virginia-based private equity firm focused on investing in defense, intelligence, and federal technology solutions providers, announced today the formation of its Board of Advisors, which includes five renowned industry leaders. The Board will provide strategic guidance and subject matter expertise to Bluestone and its portfolio companies.

"Bluestone considers the defense and government services industry to be the leadership sector because it's a community of outstanding leaders that are as committed to the mission and operating with integrity as they are to creating great companies. Our Board of Advisors fits this description perfectly. We look forward to their engagement with Bluestone and our portfolio companies," said John Allen, Managing Partner of Bluestone.

articles.title: Bluestone Appoints Former SAP NS2 CEO Mark Testoni Executive Chairman of cBEYONData
articles.excerpt: Mark Testoni has joined cBEYONData's board as Executive Chairman, bringing unparalleled expertise to drive corporate strategy and fuel growth initiatives.

paragraphs: cBEYONData LLC, a portfolio company of Bluestone Investment Partners, announced today that Mr. Mark Testoni has joined the board as Executive Chairman. With his unparalleled expertise and strategic guidance, he will collaborate with the board, the CEO, and the management team to drive corporate strategy, fuel marketing & growth initiatives, identify and pursue acquisitions, and foster innovation in solutions development.

Mark's leadership and visionary mindset ensure that cBEYONData remains at the forefront of delivering mission-critical solutions like the award-winning CFO Control Tower and Budget and Spend modules to federal agencies, empowering them to enhance business processes, leverage advanced analytics, and optimize enterprise resource planning (ERP).

articles.title: Longtime CACI CFO, Tom Mutryn, Joins Bluestone
articles.excerpt: Thomas Mutryn, most recently Chief Financial Officer for CACI International, has joined Bluestone Investment Partners as an Executive Partner.

paragraphs: Bluestone Investment Partners, LP, a McLean, Virginia-based private equity firm focused on investing in defense, intelligence, and federal technology solutions providers, announced today Mr. Thomas (Tom) Mutryn joined the team as an Executive Partner. Most recently, Mr. Mutryn served as Chief Financial Officer for CACI International, a $6.6 billion dollar firm with over 22,000 employees supporting U.S. Federal government clients.

Mr. Mutryn founded and operates Mike's Place, a nonprofit organization providing recovery housing. He is on the board or advises The Ruddie Memorial Youth Foundation, Changing Perceptions, Arise & Flourish, and the Foundation for Drug Policy Solutions. Mr. Mutryn attended Cornell University where he studied architecture and engineering, and after a short career in engineering, returned to Cornell to earn a Master of Business Administration.

articles.title: Bluestone Completes Investment in Precise Systems
articles.excerpt: Precise Systems has received a strategic investment by Bluestone Investment Partners to accelerate the growth of its mission readiness and software development services business.

paragraphs: Precise Systems, Inc. has received a strategic investment by Bluestone Investment Partners, a McLean, Virginia-based private equity firm, to accelerate the growth of its business. Founded in 1990, Precise Systems is a Lexington Park, Maryland-based provider of mission readiness and software development services to the U.S. Navy, U.S. Marine Corps and U.S. Air Force.

Coincident with the transaction, former Precise Systems President Scott Pfister has assumed the role of Chief Executive Officer. As part of the transaction, Mr. Pfister and former Chief Executive Officer, Tom Curtis, will join Precise Systems' board of directors.

articles.title: CTI Announces Acquisition of Rapid Imaging Technologies
articles.excerpt: Chesapeake Technology International (CTI) has acquired Rapid Imaging Technologies LLC, strengthening its offerings in situational awareness and video analytics technologies.

paragraphs: Chesapeake Technology International, Inc. (CTI), a provider of high-end software and systems development products for the defense and intelligence communities, announced today that it has acquired Rapid Imaging Technologies LLC. The acquisition will strengthen CTI's offerings and expand its capabilities in situational awareness and video analytics technologies.

Rapid Imaging brings over 25 years of experience in developing state-of-the-art software and imaging solutions for the defense and intelligence communities. Rapid Imaging's patented technology allows for real-time geospatial situational awareness information on live video, providing critical intelligence to military customers.

articles.title: Bluestone Closes Third Investment Fund
articles.excerpt: Bluestone Investment Partners has raised $196 million for its third buyout fund and intends to expand investments in the lower-middle government services industry.

paragraphs: Bluestone Investment Partners has raised $196 million for the private equity firm's third buyout fund and intends to expand investments in the lower-middle government services industry. The Bluestone Investment Partners III fund received commitments from endowments, family offices and gatekeepers and reached its hard cap within six months.

"Our team looks forward to continuing our strategy of partnering with lower-middle market government services businesses and helping them achieve transformational growth," said Eric Wolking, a partner at Bluestone. "We are beyond grateful for the immense support we've received from both our existing and new limited partners," added John Allen, a co-founder and managing partner of Bluestone.

articles.title: cBEYONData Announces Acquisition of Summit2Sea Consulting
articles.excerpt: cBEYONData has completed the acquisition of Summit2Sea Consulting, a provider of data analytics, robotic process automation, and enterprise application modernization across marquee DoD programs.

paragraphs: cBEYONData LLC announced today it has completed the acquisition of Summit2Sea Consulting, LLC. Founded in 2003, Summit2Sea is a provider of data analytics, robotic process automation, and enterprise application modernization across marquee DoD programs. With technology partnerships that include Oracle, Amazon Web Services, and UiPath®, Summit2Sea complements cBEYONData's existing partnerships with SAP®, CGI Momentum®, and OneStream®.

Dyson Richards, Chief Executive Officer of cBEYONData, said, "The addition of Summit2Sea expands the capabilities and expertise of cBEYONData so that we are able to support the needs of customers across the federal government across all financial and ERP platforms."

articles.title: cBEYONData Announces Acquisition of Alta Via Consulting
articles.excerpt: cBEYONData has completed the acquisition of Alta Via Consulting, a premier provider of ERP consulting services centered around SAP solutions.

paragraphs: cBEYONData LLC announced today it has completed the acquisition of Alta Via Consulting, LLC. Founded in 1998, Alta Via Consulting is a premier provider of ERP consulting services centered around improving clients' operations by maximizing value from existing business processes and information systems.

As an SAP development partner since its inception, Alta Via possesses a unique blend of SAP, process, industry, and design knowledge. The combined firm will have over 240 employees delivering ERP architecture and design, business intelligence, financial management, cloud migration and robotic process automation solutions.

articles.title: Bluestone Completes Investment in cBEYONData
articles.excerpt: Bluestone Investment Partners has completed an investment in cBEYONData, a professional services and solutions company specializing in supporting mission-driven agencies with business process automation and data analytics.

paragraphs: Bluestone Investment Partners II, LP, a McLean, Virginia-based private equity firm, is pleased to announce the completion of an investment in cBEYONData. cBEYONData is a professional services and solutions company specializing in supporting mission-driven agencies and organizations with the enhancement and automation of business processes, cloud migrations and enablement, business intelligence, data management and warehouses, data analytics, and agile project and process management.

cBEYONData primarily provides these solutions to government Chief Financial Officer-level executives at multiple law enforcement, civilian, and defense agencies. The Company's CFO Control Tower® suite is a scalable on-demand solution that enhances federal government financial systems reporting and allows clients to quickly automate business process and reduce the time spent on data aggregation and manipulation.

articles.title: Intrepid Solutions and Services Announces Acquisition of Darkblade Systems
articles.excerpt: Intrepid Solutions and Services has acquired Darkblade Systems Corp., nearly doubling Intrepid's size and expanding its ability to deliver advanced technology products and services to the intelligence community.

paragraphs: Intrepid Solutions and Services LLC, a leading provider of IT modernization, cybersecurity, analytics and advanced intelligence training services to customers across the U.S. intelligence community, announced today it has acquired intelligence solutions firm Darkblade Systems Corp. The acquisition nearly doubles Intrepid's size and further grows its ability to deliver advanced technology products and services to the IC.

"Welcoming Darkblade Systems into the Intrepid family is a transformative moment for us, one that will greatly benefit our customers, partners and entire team," said Ryan Hebert, CEO of Intrepid. "As many of our employees are veterans of the agencies we support, our teams share an ongoing commitment to serve the national security mission."

articles.title: Bluestone Completes Investment in CTI
articles.excerpt: Bluestone Investment Partners has acquired majority ownership of Chesapeake Technology International (CTI), a contractor that provides software and systems development services to defense customers.

paragraphs: Bluestone Investment Partners has acquired majority ownership of Chesapeake Technology International (CTI), a contractor that provides software and systems development services to defense customers. CTI CEO Dustan Hellwig retains a significant stake in the company and will continue to lead it.

CTI uses open and government-open software and systems development to build user-focused systems for command and control, electronic warfare, cyber-spectral operations and other military and security applications. Customers include combatant commands, theater special operations commands, service components, and other defense programs of record across the Pentagon's components.

articles.title: John Allen Featured on Washington Technology Podcast: How Small Businesses Can Be M&A Players Too
articles.excerpt: Bluestone Investment Partners co-founder John Allen discusses how small businesses in the $15M–$50M revenue range can participate in M&A activity with the right private equity partner.

paragraphs: In a crowded mergers and acquisitions environment, Bluestone Investment Partners has carved out its own niche by focusing on companies in the $15 million-to-$50 million revenue range. They often are just emerging from the small business set-aside arena and seek more resources to compete for full and open opportunities.

John Allen, co-founder and managing partner of Bluestone Investment Partners, shares in this episode the philosophy and strategy that drives how the firm made its deals in recent years. Large and mid-size companies typically dominate M&A activity, but Allen explains there is no reason that a small business can't participate as well — with the right partner.

articles.title: Continental Mapping Consultants Announces Acquisition of GISinc
articles.excerpt: Continental Mapping Consultants has completed the acquisition of Geographic Information Services, Inc. (GISinc), creating one of the largest pure-play geospatial services and solutions companies in North America.

paragraphs: Continental Mapping Consultants, LLC announced today it has completed the acquisition of Geographic Information Services, Inc. (GISinc) creating one of the largest, pure play geospatial services and solutions companies in North America with offices in five states and over 350 employees distributed across 30 states.

Continental Mapping's acquisition of GISinc provides clients with broad, complementary geospatial capabilities ranging from geospatial data collection, curation and management to the design and implementation of best-in-class enterprise systems. GISinc is a provider of GIS-enabled services and solutions for the US Army, Navy, Air Force, and Marine Corps, Federal agencies such as the Bureau of Land Management, state and local governments, airport authorities, energy, healthcare, and other commercial sectors.

articles.title: Bluestone Appoints GovCon Leader Dennis Kelly Executive Chairman of Intrepid
articles.excerpt: Bluestone Investment Partners has appointed Dennis Kelly, a well-known leader in the federal government contracting community, as executive chairman of its portfolio company Intrepid Solutions and Services.

paragraphs: Bluestone Investment Partners, LLC, a leading private equity firm focused on investing in defense, intelligence and federal technology solutions providers, announced today it has appointed Dennis Kelly as executive chairman of its portfolio company, Intrepid Solutions and Services, LLC.

Kelly is a well-known and highly respected leader in the federal government contracting community and a Navy veteran. He brings Intrepid and Bluestone over 32 years of experience in the defense and intelligence community, having served in multiple chief executive officer, president and chief operating officer roles with fast growing companies in the national security market including Anteon, A-T Solutions, Buchanan & Edwards, IOMAXIS, PAE and TechTeam Government Solutions.

articles.title: Continental Mapping Consultants Announces Acquisition of TSG Solutions
articles.excerpt: Continental Mapping Consultants has completed the acquisition of TSG Solutions, a global provider of situational awareness and geospatial services, significantly strengthening its national security capabilities.

paragraphs: Continental Mapping Consultants, LLC announced today it has completed the acquisition of TSG Solutions, Inc., a global provider of situational awareness, geospatial services, and proprietary solutions for secured and unclassified environments. For almost 20 years, TSG has delivered GIS-enabled services and solutions to clients including the Department of Defense, the energy sector and major utilities solving national security, critical infrastructure, and facility challenges.

Mike Ivey, Managing Director of Bluestone added, "Bluestone is committed to helping Continental Mapping identify value added acquisitions in the geospatial data analytics market and helping the Continental Mapping founders and executive team execute on their ambitious strategy."

articles.title: Intrepid Announces Acquisition of a Business Unit of Delta Solutions and Strategies
articles.excerpt: Intrepid Solutions and Services has completed the acquisition of a business unit of Delta Solutions and Strategies, LLC, including a GSA OASIS Pool 4 contract vehicle.

paragraphs: Intrepid Solutions and Services, LLC is pleased to announce it has completed the acquisition of a business unit of Delta Solutions and Strategies, LLC. The business unit's assets include the General Services Administration OASIS Pool 4 contract vehicle.

This transaction represents Intrepid's second acquisition since receiving an investment from Bluestone Investment Partners less than a year ago. Delta Solutions & Strategies, LLC was founded in 2000 and is a Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business providing advisory & assistance services, operations and maintenance, modeling and simulation, and training and education support to dozens of mission critical Defense and Civil Government stakeholders.

articles.title: Bluestone Completes Investment in Continental Mapping Consultants
articles.excerpt: Bluestone Investment Partners has completed an investment in Continental Mapping Consultants, a rapidly growing geospatial data analytics and mapping solutions provider.

paragraphs: Bluestone Investment Partners, LLC, a McLean, Virginia-based private equity firm, is pleased to announce the completion of an investment in Continental Mapping Consultants, LLC. Based in Sun Prairie, Wisconsin, Continental Mapping is a rapidly growing geospatial data analytics and mapping solutions provider to Defense, intelligence, federal and state government agencies, and commercial customers.

John Allen, co-founder and Managing Partner of Bluestone said, "We are excited about our partnership with Continental Mapping. The Company has a 20-year track record of successful delivery of complicated solutions, a great leadership team, a talented and technically differentiated workforce, and attractive clients."

articles.title: Intrepid Announces the Acquisition of BWM Outcomes
articles.excerpt: Intrepid Solutions and Services has completed the acquisition of BWM Outcomes, a provider of cybersecurity and intelligence analysis services to defense, intelligence, and national security customers.

paragraphs: Bluestone Investment Partners, LLC is pleased to announce that its portfolio company, Intrepid Solutions and Services, Inc. has completed the acquisition of BWM Outcomes, LLC. BWM is a provider of cybersecurity and intelligence analysis services, including: cyber threat intelligence; information assurance; intrusion detection and remediation; data analytics; document and media exploitation; and improvised threat analytics to defense, intelligence, and national security customers.

BWM was founded by Mrs. Jacqueline Bahe. Prior to starting BWM, Mrs. Bahe served in the United States armed forces as a Communications and Intelligence Officer in the Marine Corps and an Intelligence Officer in the Navy. Mrs. Bahe will join Intrepid's leadership team as BWM President.

articles.title: Bluestone Completes Investment in Intrepid Solutions and Services
articles.excerpt: Bluestone Investment Partners has completed an investment in Intrepid Solutions and Services, a premier provider of enterprise IT, data analysis, and operational training services to the U.S. Intelligence Community.

paragraphs: Bluestone Investment Partners, LLC, a McLean, Virginia-based private equity firm, is pleased to announce the completion of an investment in Intrepid Solutions and Services, Inc. Based in Sterling, Virginia, Intrepid is a premier provider of enterprise IT, data analysis, and operational training services exclusively to customers in the U.S. Intelligence Community.

Bill Strang, co-founder and Managing Partner of Bluestone said, "We are excited about our partnership with Intrepid. The Company has an excellent reputation for delivering quality services and solutions, and its leadership team and talented employees are committed to supporting the important mission of its IC customer base."

articles.title: Bluestone Completes Investment in Quadel Consulting and Training
articles.excerpt: HCI Equity Partners completed the sale of Quadel Consulting & Training to Bluestone Investment Partners. Quadel is a national expert in HUD-assisted affordable housing programs.

paragraphs: HCI Equity Partners completed the sale of Quadel Consulting & Training to Bluestone Investment Partners. Quadel, headquartered in Washington, DC, provides outsourced program management, contract administration, disaster recovery, consulting, training and educational services to various federal, local and state agencies.

Quadel is a national expert in the HUD-Assisted Multifamily, Public Housing, Housing Choice Voucher, and Low Income Housing Tax Credit programs. The Company operates in a specialized niche with significant intellectual property and serves as a leading provider of outsourced program management, consulting, and training services enabling federal, state, and local organizations to realize cost savings, improve performance, and expand the effectiveness of affordable housing programs.

articles.title: Bluestone Investment Partners Raises New Private Equity Fund
articles.excerpt: Bluestone Investment Partners has announced the initial closing of a new $75 million fund aimed at bringing transformational capital to small businesses in the defense and government services sector.

paragraphs: Bluestone Investment Partners, LLC, a McLean, Virginia-based private equity firm, is pleased to announce the initial closing of a new $75.0 million fund aimed at bringing transformational capital to small businesses in the defense and government services sector.

"Some of the most successful companies in the defense and government services sector have used mergers and acquisitions to accelerate growth and create shareholder value," said John Allen, who co-founded the Bluestone fund. "The extensive M&A and industry-focused experience of our team will allow us to bring value-added capital to small companies in the sector and help them execute transformational acquisition strategies."

articles.title: Bluestone Completes the Sale of GAP Solutions to System One
articles.excerpt: Professional staffing company System One has acquired government services contractor GAP Solutions, adding 400 employees and expanding its offerings across federal defense and civilian arenas.

paragraphs: Professional staffing company System One has acquired government services contractor GAP Solutions in a push to grow offerings across the federal defense and civilian arenas. Terms of the transaction were undisclosed and GAP Solutions will add 400 employees to System One.

Herndon, Va.-based GAP Solutions was founded in 1999 and focuses on the areas of human capital management, security process management, scientific and technical knowledge, and operations management. Investment bank Bluestone Capital Partners handled the GAP Solutions transaction.

articles.title: Bluestone Completes the Sale of CIS Secure Computing to Acorn Growth Companies
articles.excerpt: Acorn Growth Companies has acquired CIS Secure Computing, a leading provider of secure communications equipment and computing solutions for U.S. Government customers.

paragraphs: Acorn Growth Companies, a private equity firm investing exclusively in Aerospace & Defense, announced it has acquired CIS Secure Computing, Inc., headquartered in Dulles, Virginia. The acquisition marks Acorn's second in the defense electronics segment.

"CIS has a proven track record and excellent past performance proving that sometimes the best solutions to software weaknesses are hardware solutions. CIS is the undisputed market leader in providing these solutions to the United States Departments of Defense and Energy, and is poised to support America's need for greater network security," said Rick Nagel, Managing Partner for Acorn. Advisory services were provided by Bluestone Capital Partners.

articles.title: Bluestone Exits its Investment in OMNIPLEX World Services Corporation with its Sale to Constellis
articles.excerpt: Constellis has agreed to purchase OMNIPLEX World Services for an undisclosed sum, adding investigative services to its portfolio and expanding its client base in the U.S. intelligence community.

paragraphs: Reston, Virginia-based risk management and operational support services contractor Constellis has agreed to purchase OMNIPLEX World Services for an undisclosed sum in a push to add the latter's investigative services to its portfolio and expand its client base in the U.S. intelligence community.

Chantilly, Virginia-based OMNIPLEX operates with approximately 2,100 employees and 1,700 investigators that work to provide risk management, investigative and physical security support services to federal agencies across homeland security, law enforcement and intelligence communities. Bluestone Capital Partners served as financial advisor in the transaction.

articles.title: Bluestone Completes Investment in GAP Solutions with Industry Veterans Eric Wolking and Pat Flannery
articles.excerpt: GAP Solutions has been acquired by an entity led by Eric Wolking and Pat Flannery, former Stanley Associates executives, with Bluestone Investment Partners playing an integral role in facilitating the transaction.

paragraphs: GAP Solutions, Inc., a leading provider of professional and technical services primarily to civilian agency customers, is pleased to announce the recent acquisition of the Company by an entity led by Eric Wolking and Pat Flannery. Messrs. Wolking and Flannery are former Stanley Associates, Inc. executives with 35 years of combined operational, strategic, business development and merger and acquisition experience in the government services industry.

Bluestone Investment Partners played an integral role in the acquisition of GAP Solutions, identifying the opportunity for Messrs. Wolking and Flannery, leading due diligence, and facilitating financing for the transaction. "The Bluestone team was critical to the success of our transaction with GAP Solutions," said Pat Flannery.

articles.title: Bluestone Completes Investment in CIS Secure Computing
articles.excerpt: Bluestone Investment Partners has made an investment in CIS Secure Computing, a leading provider of secure communications and computing solutions to defense and civilian agency customers.

paragraphs: Bluestone Investment Partners, the private equity affiliate of Bluestone Capital Partners, announced today that it has made an investment in CIS Secure Computing, Inc. CIS is a leading provider of secure communications and computing solutions to defense and civilian agency customers. Established in 1992, CIS designs and engineers a broad range of products based on commercial-off-the-shelf technologies to meet unique government requirements.

Bill Strang, Managing Partner of the Bluestone fund, said, "We are pleased to partner with CIS. The company has an outstanding reputation for delivering quality products and solutions. We are eager to bring additional resources to the business so that it can expand its reach and product offerings and accelerate growth."

articles.title: Bluestone Closes Private Equity Fund
articles.excerpt: McLean-based investment bank Bluestone Capital Partners has closed a private equity fund focused on defense and government services companies, targeting lower middle-market businesses.

paragraphs: McLean-based investment bank Bluestone Capital Partners is expanding into the private equity business with the close of a fund aimed at small firms in the defense and government services sector.
Bluestone Investment Partners will target lower middle-market companies in the defense and government services arena, providing capital and strategic guidance to help them grow.

teamMembers.name: John Allen
teamMembers.title: Managing Partner
bio: John Allen is co-founder and Managing Partner of Bluestone Investment Partners, a private equity group focused on investing in small defense and government services companies. John has spent more than two decades in private equity and investment banking focused on the middle market aerospace, defense, and government sector. John has been involved in more than 150 merger and acquisition transactions with a wide range of companies including some of the biggest names in the market such as CACI International, General Dynamics, Lockheed Martin, ManTech, Raytheon, SAIC, The Carlyle Group, and Veritas Capital.

Because of his success and thought leadership, John has received many industry accolades. He is frequently interviewed as an industry expert and has had articles and quotes published in many leading periodicals. John has also briefed members of Congress and congressional committees on issues important to small and middle-market businesses.

John's experience includes serving as a Managing Director in Houlihan Lokey's Aerospace, Defense and Government Services Group. John was also co-owner of Windsor Group before it was acquired by BB&T Corporation in 2005. While at Windsor Group, John co-founded Windsor Capital Partners Fund I, a private equity/mezzanine fund focused on investing in small and middle-market companies in the defense and government services space.

Before joining Windsor Group, John was President of Quarterdeck Investment Partners, an investment banking firm focused on the aerospace, defense, and government market. He helped lead Quarterdeck from a start-up to the eventual sale of a minority position to Jefferies & Company.

John has served on boards of multiple businesses and charitable organizations including BB&T Capital Partners | Windsor Mezzanine Fund, CIS Secure Computing, GAP Solutions and Iron Bow Technologies. Additionally, John has served on the boards of Northern Virginia Technology Council and Northern Virginia Family Service.
John attended the M.B.A. program at American University and earned a Bachelor of Arts degree in Political Science from the University of Florida.

teamMembers.name: Gray Beck
teamMembers.title: Operating Partner
bio: Gray Beck is a finance executive with more than fifteen years of experience leading the financial operations of professional services businesses serving government customers. He has served as Chief Financial Officer of two Bluestone portfolio companies, cBEYONData and Quadel, scaling both platforms through periods of growth and operational professionalization.
Gray holds an M.S. in Finance and a B.A. in Economics from Washington University in St. Louis, and is a certified PMP.

teamMembers.name: Joe Collins
teamMembers.title: Vice President
bio: Joe Collins serves as a Vice President on the Bluestone team working on deal sourcing and execution, portfolio company monitoring and valuation, and industry and company research.

Prior to joining Bluestone, Joe was a Senior Associate at EY in their Valuation, Modeling and Economics group where he focused primarily on public and private company and security valuations for financial reporting and tax purposes. Joe has also been a Teaching Assistant with Training the Street since completing graduate school and has worked with hundreds of students on courses ranging from financial modeling, merger consequences and leveraged buyout analysis and corporate valuation. Prior to his career in finance, Joe was 1st Lieutenant in the United States Army where he served as a platoon leader and logistics staff officer in the 2nd Armored Brigade Combat Team, 4th Infantry Division stationed out of Fort Carson, Colorado.
Joe has his M.B.A. with a concentration in Finance from Fordham Gabelli School of Business and a B.S. in Business Management from Clemson University.

teamMembers.name: Kevin Doherty
teamMembers.title: Principal
bio: Kevin Doherty is a Principal at Bluestone Investment Partners, where he evaluates acquisition opportunities, collaborates with portfolio management teams on corporate development, and supports fundraising and investor relations. Kevin joined Bluestone from Redwood Holdings, a holding company for a founder of Allegis Group, where he was responsible for evaluating investment opportunities and assisting in portfolio company management across a range of industries. Prior to Redwood, Kevin worked in investment banking with Houlihan Lokey, where he advised clients on a number of merger and acquisition advisory engagements across the aerospace, defense, and government services sector.
Kevin received a B.A. from the University of Virginia.

teamMembers.name: Ben Dower
teamMembers.title: Principal
bio: Ben Dower holds the position of Principal at Bluestone Investment Partners. His professional background spans more than 15 years in corporate finance, encompassing roles as an investment banker, strategy consultant, and operational finance professional within the defense, technology, and cybersecurity sectors.

From 2015 through 2021, Dower occupied senior positions focused on finance and strategy at software companies in the security space. He served as Vice President of Finance at Cybrary, a cybersecurity workforce development platform, where his responsibilities covered finance, accounting, investor relations, sales operations, legal, and compliance functions. During his tenure there, he led the raising of over $20 million in capital to fund the company's rapid growth, including its 2019 Series B financing.

Before joining Bluestone, Dower held senior corporate development positions at software firms operating at the intersection of technology and national security, including Endgame, SAP NS2, and Haystax Technology.

His earlier career included a decade advising defense and technology sector companies. He began at BB&T Capital Markets as an investment banker, subsequently transitioning to The Chertoff Group as a Director, where he focused on strategy development, risk management, and merger and acquisition support.
His educational credentials include a B.A. in International Studies from Johns Hopkins University and an M.B.A. from the Tuck School of Business at Dartmouth College.

teamMembers.name: Michael Ivey
teamMembers.title: Partner
bio: As a Partner at Bluestone, Mike Ivey brings 19 years of private equity investing, investment banking, corporate finance, and operations experience in the defense and government services industry. As a Senior Vice President at a boutique investment bank focused on defense and government services he directed a number of high-profile mergers and acquisitions for both publicly traded and private-equity backed platforms in the government sector. Additionally, he has helped multiple clients optimize their capital structure to enhance equity value.

Prior to his investment banking role, Mike was Vice President of Finance for NetStar-1, Inc., a portfolio company of Lake Capital. In this role, he oversaw most of the company's corporate financial matters including strategic planning, financial reporting, and M&A, including financial due diligence and integration activities. Mike played a significant role in the acquisition and integration of a $75 million acquisition in April 2008 and the divestiture of NetStar-1's IT Services division in October 2010.

Prior to NetStar-1, Mike served as the Vice President of Finance for Anteon International Corporation (NYSE: ANT), a $1.5 billion government services provider. In this position, he was responsible for all financial activities for a $450 million strategic business unit. His duties included directing the business unit's strategic planning, risk management, and financial statements and reporting. Prior to this role, Mike directed Anteon's corporate Financial Planning and Analysis department. He was a key member of Anteon's M&A team which completed a series of acquisitions from 2000 through 2005 in addition to completing an IPO in 2002 and subsequent secondary offering in 2003.
Mike has an M.B.A. with an emphasis in corporate finance and a Bachelor of Science in Finance from Virginia Tech.

teamMembers.name: Jay Moorman
teamMembers.title: Operating Partner
bio: Dr. Moorman is a technology leader with over 20 years of experience developing and implementing government and commercial solutions that drive transformative growth. He has held the role of CEO at multiple Bluestone portfolio companies and led the sale of Chesapeake Technology Inc. ("CTI") to Parsons Corporation in 2025.

Prior to joining CTI, Dr. Moorman created scalable, cutting-edge solutions in support of the U.S. defense and intelligence communities with Bell Labs, Alcatel-Lucent, and LGS Innovations. He most recently served as senior vice president for CACI International's Wireless Solutions division. In this role, Dr. Moorman led innovations that spanned across multiple disciplines such as 5G communications, software defined radios, and resilient architectures.

teamMembers.name: Bill Mutryn
teamMembers.title: Partner
bio: As a Partner at Bluestone, Bill Mutryn brings over 40 years of experience as a practicing attorney, most of which has been representing clients in merger and acquisition transactions in the aerospace, defense, government services, healthcare, consumer products, and staffing space. Prior to joining Bluestone Bill was a co-leader of Holland & Knight's Corporate and Mergers and Acquisitions Practice Group, and served as a member of Holland & Knight's Directors Committee for 6 years. During the past two decades, Bill has served as lead counsel in over 150 merger and acquisition transactions.

Bill is admitted to practice law in Virginia and also has been a member of the bars of Maryland, the District of Columbia and numerous federal courts. Bill is a former president of the Association for Corporate Growth, National Capital Chapter, and he has written articles and lectured on a wide range of business law subjects. He has been named by his peers in several editions of The Best Lawyers in America for Corporate Law, Mergers & Acquisitions Law, as well as Leveraged Buyouts and Private Equity Law.

Bill also served as an adjunct professor at The George Washington University Law School, teaching "Mergers and Acquisitions of Private Entities" and is on the law school's Board of Advisors. Currently Bill is a member of the Board of Advisors of Cordia Partners and serves on the Board of Directors of National Technologies Associates and Applied Phage Therapeutics.
During law school, Bill was a member of the Order of the Coif and The George Washington Law Review.
Bill graduated with honors from the George Washington University Law School and has a Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering from Case Western Reserve University.

teamMembers.name: Tom Mutryn
teamMembers.title: Executive Partner
bio: Tom Mutryn serves as Executive Partner, advising portfolio companies on operational best practices and M&A activities. He retired from CACI International in 2023 after spending over 16 years as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, managing financial operations for the $6.5 billion government contractor. During his tenure, he oversaw accounting, tax, compliance, and treasury functions while supporting over 30 acquisition deals totaling $4 billion in combined value.

Prior leadership roles include Chief Financial Officer positions at GTSI Corp. (a publicly traded reseller) and US Airways. He also held finance positions at United Airlines and American Airlines, where he managed financing for over $8 billion in aircraft acquisitions.

Tom is active in nonprofit work, serving on boards for Mike's Place, The Ruddie Memorial Youth Foundation, Changing Perceptions, Arise & Flourish, and The Foundation for Drug Policy Solutions. He holds degrees from Cornell University: undergraduate study in architecture and engineering, plus an MBA.

teamMembers.name: Kevin Phillips
teamMembers.title: Executive Partner
bio: Kevin Phillips is a government services executive with 38 years of career experience, including over 20 years in leadership at ManTech International. He currently serves as Chairman of the Board at ManTech (9,800 employees) and led the company's successful sale to Carlyle Group in September 2022 for $4.2 billion.

Previous roles include President and CEO (2018–2022), COO (2016–2018), and CFO (2005–2016). He is active in industry organizations including the Professional Services Council and Northern Virginia Technology Council, and has received numerous awards including Federal Computer Week's 2019 Federal 100 and the Wash100 for six consecutive years.

Phillips serves on the boards of the National Cryptologic Foundation and CIA Officers Memorial Foundation. He is a U.S. Army Reserves veteran with 10 years of service and holds a Business Administration degree from William & Mary.

teamMembers.name: Richard Smithies
teamMembers.title: Associate
bio: Richard Smithies is an Associate at Bluestone Investment Partners, where he concentrates on deal sourcing and execution, portfolio company monitoring, and industry and company research.

Before his current role, he worked as an Investment Banking Analyst at Bank of America's New York office, advising clients on mergers and acquisitions, capital raises, and corporate carve-outs within the aerospace, defense, and government services sector. He earned a B.S. in Finance from Florida State University.

teamMembers.name: Bill Strang
teamMembers.title: Managing Partner
bio: Bill Strang is co-founder and Managing Partner at Bluestone Investment Partners. He brings extensive sales, operations, and executive leadership experience from both government services and commercial sectors.

Prior to Bluestone, Strang founded and served as principal executive at three separate companies, two of which focused exclusively on defense and government services. His first venture, Sylvest Management Systems Corp., capitalized on federal procurement reform in the early 1990s by securing Government-wide Acquisition Contracts (GWACs). The Carlyle Group purchased the firm for $50 million in 1997.

His second company, TimeBridge Technologies—spun from Sylvest's commercial division—grew from $3 million to $140 million in revenue within four years through organic expansion and acquisitions. Dimension Data acquired it for $150 million in 2001. In 2002, Strang founded NetStar-1, Inc., focused on federal IT solutions. Lake Capital acquired a majority stake in 2007, with Acentia purchasing an additional portion in 2010. Strang holds a Bachelor's degree from Eastern Kentucky University.

teamMembers.name: Kyle Strang
teamMembers.title: Vice President
bio: Kyle Strang is a Vice President at Bluestone Investment Partners focusing on deal sourcing and execution, portfolio company monitoring, and industry and company research. Prior to joining Bluestone, he worked as a manager at Pipaya Partners, a boutique M&A consulting firm, where he led buy-side and sell-side financial diligence engagements in the aerospace, defense and government services industry. He holds a B.S. in Finance and Business Analytics from Drexel University.

teamMembers.name: Christie Wetzel
teamMembers.title: Director of Fund Operations
bio: Christie Wetzel oversees fund reporting, compliance, and management at Bluestone while directing marketing and investor engagement efforts. She brings 10 years of experience in private equity and investment banking operations, along with prior corporate strategy work at Química Mediterránea Industrial (QUIMSA).
Her educational background includes an M.B.A. from the University of Málaga and dual Bachelor of Arts degrees in International Business & Management and Spanish from Dickinson College.

teamMembers.name: Tom Weston
teamMembers.title: Operating Partner
bio: Tom Weston is an executive with 35 years of experience in the federal contracting industry having served in senior roles for both publicly traded and private equity held technology companies. Most recently, Tom was the Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of ECS Federal, LLC, a leading provider of advanced technologies and solutions in the cloud, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and IT systems modernization areas.

His extensive knowledge and experience in matters associated with companies contracting with the U.S. Government, including those that are subject to the Federal Acquisition Regulation and Cost Accounting Standards, will further strengthen and support the long-term success of our organization. During his career, Tom has led over 40 M&A and financing transactions as both a buyer and a seller.

Tom graduated from James Madison University with a Bachelor of Business Administration degree and currently sits on the Board of Directors for several entities, where he also serves as chair of the audit committee.

teamMembers.name: George Wilson
teamMembers.title: Operating Partner
bio: George Wilson has decades of leadership experience from both the military and private sectors. A graduate of the U.S. Naval Academy, George began his career as a commissioned officer in 1979, where he played a key role in advanced submarine construction.

Following his military service, he transitioned to the private sector, where he earned a reputation for driving substantial business growth. At Stanley Associates, George helped expand the organization from a 20-person operation to a publicly listed company with 5,000 employees. His strategic leadership was instrumental in the company's acquisition by CGI Inc. for $1 billion.

Later, as President and CEO of ECS Federal, George spearheaded a remarkable transformation, growing annual revenue from $120 million to over $1 billion during his 11-year tenure. Now serving as CEO of Valiant Solutions, George remains committed to fostering innovation, operational excellence, and sustained growth.

teamMembers.name: Eric Wolking
teamMembers.title: Partner
bio: As a Partner at Bluestone, Eric Wolking brings more than 20 years of experience in the government technology and services industry. Most recently, Eric served as the CEO of GAP Solutions from its acquisition in 2013 until its eventual sale in 2017 to System One Holdings. Prior to GAP Solutions Eric worked at Stanley Associates (NYSE: SXE) and CGI (NYSE: GIB) for over thirteen years as a senior executive in various positions helping the company to grow from $18 million in annual revenue to over $800 million in annual revenue.

At the time of Stanley's acquisition by CGI in 2010, Eric led one of three business units – the Technical Programs Group - which consisted of over 800 employees supporting the Army Communications and Electronics Command, the Army Aviation and Missile Command, Naval Sea Systems Command, the United States Patent and Trademark Office, and other clients. Following the acquisition by CGI Federal, Eric led the National Security Programs business unit, a $160 million unit providing technology solutions to Justice, Homeland Security, and Defense customers.

Prior to leading the Technical Programs Group at Stanley, Eric served as Senior Vice President of Corporate Development, leading the company's $170 million acquisition of Oberon Associates. Additional positions held include Account Manager for Federal Civilian Programs and Director of Midwest Operations.
Eric also worked with Dell Computer and Troika Networks, a Draper Fisher Jurvetson portfolio company.

Eric is the Vice Chair of the Board of Trustees of the San Miguel School of Washington, a middle school educating academically underserved and economically disadvantaged boys in the Washington, DC, metro area and is a member of the Young Presidents Organization (YPO).
Eric has an M.B.A. with an emphasis on Finance from The Anderson School at UCLA and a B.A. in International Studies and Economics from American University.
